title: A totalitárius diktatúrák áldozatainak emléknapjai (Memorial Days for Victims of Totalitarianism)
grammar: Commemorative Syntax, State Protocol & Solemn Historical Memorialization

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what February 25 and April 16 commemorate.
I can name Béla Kovács and the Danube Shoes memorial.
I can use figyelmeztetésként szolgál to say why we remember.
I can read a short text about the victims of dictatorships and answer questions about it.
